400 Bad Request when creating response with invalid model

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	request := pkg.CreateResponseRequest{
		Model: `nonexistent-model`,
		Input: json.RawMessage(`"Hello"`),
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	_, err := client.CreateResponse(request)
	var typedError pkg.Error
	if errors.As(err, &typedError) {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%T: %v\n", typedError, typedError)
	}
}
```
